youtube_short.title: Your $100K Home Equity Is Really $54,500
title_alternatives: The 4 Hidden Costs Eating Your Home Equity
What Your Home Equity REALLY Means When You Sell
youtube_short.description: Everyone watches their Zillow estimate climb — but almost nobody adds up the four cuts waiting when you sell. Realtor commissions alone take $23,100 off the median home. Add closing costs, pre-sale repairs, and potential capital gains tax and your $100K in paper equity becomes around $54,500. Know your real number before you make your next move. #realestate #homeequity #personalfinance #moneytips #sellinghome
